summary_text: On this weekend, the user ordered Amul Moti Toned Milk (450 ml) in the evening. This timing contrasts with the population baseline, which shows the highest share of milk purchases in the morning (0.3246) and evening (0.3027). The product is a long-life, ambient-stable milk, suggesting a need for immediate, ready-to-use dairy without refrigeration constraints or delivery wait times. This is a single observation on one date. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for Amul, for long-life milk specifically, or for evening/weekend ordering. No brand or product preference can be confirmed from this single instance.
